This unidentified [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] '''superweapon''' underwent construction during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. According to a set of data obtained by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it was capable of clouding entire armies from Republic radars. The main set of plans was stolen at a [[Trade Federation Rodia base|Trade Federation base]] by a clone trooper named [[Denal/Legends|Denal]], who later destroyed the weapon's construction facility, thus stopping it from completion.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (mobile)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (mobile)]]</ref>
